messages:
Maya Patel: Hey team — CloudScale asked to finalize creative for our joint launch tile in their marketplace. They need final icon/lockup, 1-paragraph customer quote, and a 72x72 SVG for the marketplace tile by EOD Thu. Can we confirm owners? Link to draft assets: https://drive.google.com/xxx :pushpin:

Tom Nguyen: I'll own the marketplace tile exports. Need the SVG and a fallback PNG. Who has the canonical CloudScale logo SVG?

Ana Ruiz: Design has the logos. @Chris Lee can you confirm the customer quote is cleared? Also double-check embargo (customer wants 2026-04-05 16:00 PT).

Chris Lee: Confirmed — customer okayed quote but asked to keep launch embargo until 2026-04-05 16:00 PT. Also: they require an attribution line 'Customer name, Title — Company' and approval on exact phrasing.

DesignBot: asset-checklist.pdf uploaded — contains export specs and alt-text guidance. (file: asset_checklist_v3.pdf)

Maya Patel: Quick checklist in-thread — please reply with ✅ when done:
```
- final CloudScale lockup (SVG)
- Redwood logo (white + color svg)
- 72x72 marketplace tile SVG + 2x PNG
- 1-paragraph approved customer quote
- customer-approved alt text
- logo usage rights confirmation from legal
- release embargo timestamp
```

Priya (Legal): Logo rights: CloudScale provided co-brand license; we need to confirm whether they require a copyright credit line. I'll review tonight and post required copy.

Tom Nguyen: Got it. I'll prepare the SVGs and PNGs by Wed EOD. ✅

Ana Ruiz: Design — can we get two lockup variants? one with CloudScale left of Redwood, one stacked. Also prefer neutral background for marketplace.

DesignBot: Uploading both variants to drive: https://drive.google.com/variantA and https://drive.google.com/variantB. Using neutral gray #F5F6F7 and transparent options. Also drafting alt-text: 'Redwood Inference and CloudScale logos; marketplace tile for joint solution' — please review.

Maya Patel: Alt-text sounds generic. Customer wanted product mention: replace with 'Redwood Inference + CloudScale — low-latency LLM inference for finance' — @Chris Lee ok?

Chris Lee: That works but customer wants 'for finance teams' at end. So: 'Redwood Inference + CloudScale — low-latency LLM inference for finance teams.'

Ana Ruiz: Noted. I'll swap alt-text and push final PNGs.

Priya (Legal): Confirmed: CloudScale wants the copyright line under the case study PDF: 'CloudScale and its logo are trademarks of CloudScale Inc.' We also need the mutual trademark statement in the partner page. Approved.

Maya Patel: Great. Two last asks: can marketing ops schedule the marketplace tile publish window to match customer embargo? Also ensure the case study PDF has footnote with logo credits.

Tom Nguyen: I can set the publish to 2026-04-05 16:05 PT (five minutes after embargo lift) in the marketplace pipeline. Will add footnote to PDF export.

Ana Ruiz: Uploading final assets to the /marketplace/final/ folder. Filename schema: cs_cloudscale_final_lockup_v2.svg, cs_marketplace_tile_72.svg, cs_tile_144.png, etc.

DesignBot: files uploaded. checksum: 3a7c... (truncated).

Maya Patel: Thank you all. I'll loop in PMM for social copy next. Leaving this thread open for any last-minute legal flags. :thumbsup:
